messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate + latency on /v1/chat (us-east-1). 5xx spike and token latency > 800ms. Incident INC-20260315-42. Paging oncall-nyc
oncall-nyc: I see the alert. Jumping in. Initial checks: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot
jamal: I can repro increased 5xx on /v1/chat; embeddings look mostly ok but rerank has a few spikes. Traces show time spent in batching layer and queueing
maria: support ticket 9872 created for affected customers (acme-corp + 2 others). They report chat timeouts, embeddings still ok for them
ken: curious — any recent changes to rate limiter rules or shielding? Could be an overaggressive global burst threshold
oncall-nyc: checking rate-limiter dashboards and per-route quotas now
support-eng: customer says failures started ~20m ago after a traffic surge from an internal campaign
jamal: traffic analysis: chat qps jumped 6x for a short window, continuous batching overwhelmed worker queues, request latencies spiked and cascade caused 503s
maria: mitigation proposals: 1) apply emergency per-route cap for chat to limit blast 2) lower rerank/embeddings consumption maybe temporarily reduce heavy rerank paths 3) route-specific token throttles for noisy API keys
oncall-nyc: agreed. Plan: apply per-route quota for /v1/chat in us-east-1 to 60 rps, bump embeddings quota to preserve embedding customers, and disable rerank-batch path to reduce backend pressure. Will record changes in audit
ken: commands to run (use redwoodctl):
```bash
redwoodctl quota update --route /v1/chat --region us-east-1 --rps 60 --burst 120 --reason "emergency: protect cluster during surge"
redwoodctl quota update --route /v1/embeddings --region us-east-1 --rps 250 --burst 500 --reason "protect embeddings traffic"
redwoodctl feature toggle set --feature rerank-batch-path --state disabled --reason "reduce worker queue pressure"
```
jamal: applying chat quota now
jamal: ✅ API response: quota change accepted (change_id: chg-8342) for /v1/chat @ us-east-1 -> 60rps
maria: applying embeddings bump
maria: ✅ embeddings quota updated -> 250rps
ken: disabling rerank-batch path
ken: ✅ feature toggle applied, will take effect within 10-15s
incident-bot: Action executed by jamal; audit: chg-8342; feature toggle chg-8343
oncall-nyc: monitoring: within 90s latency for /v1/chat p95 dropped from 980ms -> 310ms, 5xx rate down to 3.2% from 18%
support-eng: notified affected customers that we've applied mitigations and are monitoring; provided temporary per-endpoint limits and ETA for follow-up
customer-success: acknowledged. We'll update accounts and offer postmortem once stabilized
jamal: note: we throttled chat globally in region; some high-throughput customers will see errors — we should proactively whitelist critical enterprise keys if needed
maria: created INF-1204 to investigate root cause: batching queue saturation + KV cache eviction pattern; includes tasks for better per-route backpressure and graceful degradation
ken: follow-up quick fixes: add route-specific soft quotas per api-key, enforce fair-share across keys, add faster kill-switch for heavyweight features like rerank-batch
oncall-nyc: handing off maintenance/watch to jamal in 30m for a 3-hour window. jamal, you take over? @jamal
jamal: taking over. I'll watch metrics and escalate if we see new anomalies. Leaving mitigation rules in place until we confirm stable for 60m
incident-bot: Incident status -> MONITORING (mitigations applied). Incident INC-20260315-42 assigned to jamal for follow-up
oncall-nyc: closing active pager; will keep thread open for follow-up notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
